ContentTypeVisibilityOptions.description: What to hide on one content type. Aliases are matched case-insensitively.

Properties.description: Property aliases to hide (own or composed).

Containers.description: Container aliases to hide: "tabAlias" hides the tab and every group under it, "tabAlias/groupAlias" hides one group, and a root-level group alias hides that group. The tab alias ends at the first slash; the group alias after it may contain slashes when the group's name does.

PropertyVisibilityOptions.description: Root options for the package, bound from the PropertyVisibility appsettings section.

Enabled.description: Kill switch. When false nothing is hidden and the API reports disabled. Default true.

ConfigFile.description: Optional rules file relative to the content root. An empty value disables the file source. When the file exists and parses it replaces ContentTypes, RuleSets and Sites wholesale.

HideEmptiedContainers.description: Also hide a group whose properties are all hidden, and a tab whose groups and own properties are all hidden. Default true. The rules file overrides it only when the file sets it.

ContentTypes.description: Rules that apply on every site, keyed by content type alias (document or element type). A rule keyed by a composition also applies to every type composed of it, where it hides only what the composition contributes.

RuleSets.description: Rules that several sites share, keyed by a free name. A site uses a set by naming it in Include.

Sites.description: Per-site rules keyed by a free label used in diagnostics.

RuleSetOptions.description: Rules that several sites share: a site uses them by naming the set in Include.

ContentTypes.description: Rules of this set, keyed by content type alias (document or element type). A rule keyed by a composition also applies to every type composed of it, where it hides only what the composition contributes.

SiteVisibilityOptions.description: Rules for one site, identified by its root node.

RootNodeKey.description: Key of the site's root node. Survives renames; the recommended identity.

RootNodeName.description: Invariant name of the site's root node, compared case-insensitively and trimmed. Used when no site matched by key. On a variant site this is the default-culture name as of the last save.

IsDefault.description: Marks the site whose rules apply to every root node no other site matched. At most one site may be the default.

Include.description: Names of the rule sets (RuleSets) this site uses, matched case-insensitively. Their rules are united with the site's own.

ContentTypes.description: Rules for this site, keyed by content type alias (document or element type). A rule keyed by a composition also applies to every type composed of it, where it hides only what the composition contributes.
